Indian-Origin Boy, 7, Achieves Grade 8 in UK GCSE Maths Exam

A 7-year-old Indian-origin boy named Jivyan has achieved a Grade 8 in the Pearson Edexcel GCSE Higher Mathematics exam in the UK. The exam is typically taken by students aged 16. Jivyan sat for the exam in May.
